critical_issues.msg: DndContext onDragEnd references handleDragEnd which is never defined, causing an uncaught ReferenceError when a drag ends.
critical_issues.suggestion: Define handleDragEnd: async function handleDragEnd(event: DragEndEvent) { const { active, over } = event; if (!over) return; const taskId = Number(active.id); const newStatus = over.id as string; await update.mutateAsync({ id: taskId, data: { status: newStatus } }); }

suggestions.msg: Plan references `@uiw/react-md-editor` but `package.json` has `react-markdown` instead — plan needs updating to reflect installed dependency
suggestions.suggestion: Replace `@uiw/react-md-editor` reference with `react-markdown` in step 5, or add `@uiw/react-md-editor` to `frontend/package.json`

suggestions.msg: Plan references old `radix-ui` package names (e.g. `Select`) but `package.json` uses `^1.4.3` which is the deprecated monolithic `radix-ui` package — plan references may be outdated
suggestions.suggestion: Verify `frontend/src/components/ui/select.tsx` exists and uses the correct `@radix-ui/react-select` package, then update the plan if needed

suggestions.msg: `crypto-js` is a dev/build-time utility but is listed in `dependencies` instead of `devDependencies`
suggestions.suggestion: Move `crypto-js` to `devDependencies` — it is not needed at runtime in production

suggestions.msg: `@tanstack/react-query-devtools` is a development tool but is in `dependencies` instead of `devDependencies`
suggestions.suggestion: Move `@tanstack/react-query-devtools` to `devDependencies` — it should not ship to production clients

suggestions.msg: `radix-ui` is pinned to `^1.4.3` (monolithic deprecated package) while the project likely uses individual packages like `@radix-ui/react-select` via a different version range
suggestions.suggestion: Verify whether `radix-ui` is actually used directly; if not, remove it; if yes, prefer the granular per-component packages

suggestions.msg: The pathname effect runs on every navigation regardless of sidebar open state, causing a superfluous re-render when sidebar is already closed
suggestions.suggestion: Guard with `if (sidebarOpen) setSidebarOpen(false);` to skip the setState call when sidebar is already closed

suggestions.msg: Empty `catch {}` block in async `onSubmit` — if React Query's `onError` is truly the only error path, the try/catch is redundant and masks bugs if the assumption changes
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the try/catch entirely and let exceptions propagate to React Query's error handling; or add explicit error state/logging to avoid silent swallow

suggestions.msg: ESLint disable comment is a code smell — the pattern is acknowledged but not cleaned up
suggestions.suggestion: Consider extracting the sidebar synchronization logic into a custom hook or state library to avoid the lint warning

suggestions.msg: Rule 16 (review guidelines) — `filteredAndSorted()` is called as a function (not memoized) so it recomputes on every render; with large task lists this causes O(N log N) recomputation on every state change
suggestions.suggestion: Wrap the result in `useMemo(() => filteredAndSorted(items, ...), [items, priorityFilter, assigneeFilter, createdAfter, createdBefore, sortKey, sortDir])` or inline the logic as a `useMemo`

suggestions.msg: Rule 12 — `statusFilter` value `"__all__"` is set when the user wants "all statuses" but the `useTasks(page, statusFilter)` call passes `"__all__"` as the API query param instead of clearing the filter
suggestions.suggestion: Map `"__all__"` to an empty string before calling `useTasks`: `const apiStatus = statusFilter === '__all__' ? '' : statusFilter;`

suggestions.msg: Rule 46 — `Promise.all` in `bulkComplete` and `bulkDelete` silently swallows individual failures; if one mutation fails, the selected set is cleared anyway
suggestions.suggestion: Use `Promise.allSettled` instead of `Promise.all` so failures are reported via React Query error state, and only clear selectedIds when all operations are done or handle partial success explicitly

suggestions.msg: Rule 31 (performance) — `filteredAndSorted()` creates intermediate arrays on every call; no caching between `toggleSelectAll` and render
suggestions.suggestion: Memoize the filtered result to avoid re-sorting when only selection state changes

suggestions.msg: Rule 15 — "Assignee" column is missing from the table even though assignee filter exists
suggestions.suggestion: Add an "Assignee" table column using `users.find(u => u.id === t.assigned_to)?.full_name ?? '—'` to make the filter useful

suggestions.msg: Rule 27 — TypeScript types for `editTask` use `Record<string, unknown>` losing all type safety; casts like `Number(t.id)` repeated throughout
suggestions.suggestion: Define a `Task` interface or use the inferred type from the API response and use a typed state

suggestions.msg: tasksByStatus is called 7 times per render without memoization, causing O(n) scans of allTasks per column per render.
suggestions.suggestion: Memoize with useMemo: const tasksByStatus = useMemo(() => { const m: Record<string, TaskData[]> = {}; for (const col of COLUMNS) m[col.id] = allTasks.filter(t => t.status === col.id); return m; }, [allTasks]);

suggestions.msg: useTasks is called with hardcoded tenant_id=1 instead of the actual authenticated tenant from context.
suggestions.suggestion: Retrieve the tenant ID from the auth context (e.g., useAuthStore) and pass it to useTasks instead of the literal 1.

suggestions.msg: PRIORITY_COLORS and COLUMNS are defined at module scope but could be typed as const for extra safety and tree-shaking.
suggestions.suggestion: Add 'as const' suffix: const COLUMNS = [{ id: "pending", ... }] as const;

suggestions.msg: Form state is initialized once on mount using the task prop; if the task prop changes (e.g., user switches which task is being edited), the form will show stale data.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a useEffect that syncs form state whenever the task prop changes: useEffect(() => { if (task) setForm({ title: String(task.title ?? ""), ... }); }, [task]);

suggestions.msg: flex-row! uses invalid Tailwind syntax — the exclamation point modifier is a V4 feature that requires Tailwind V4 to work and is not universally supported.
suggestions.suggestion: Replace className="flex-row! justify-between" with className="flex flex-row justify-between gap-2 sm:justify-between" or simply flex-row (which is already the default).

suggestions.msg: useUsers and useOpportunities are called with page=1 and no search filter, potentially fetching large unpaginated lists that are used only for dropdown population.
suggestions.suggestion: Consider passing a reasonable page_size limit (e.g., 100) to avoid fetching unnecessary data when only populating a dropdown.

suggestions.msg: The initialStatus prop is accepted but not used in the initial form state when task is provided — the form always uses task.status when editing, ignoring initialStatus after first mount.
suggestions.suggestion: Ensure initialStatus is consumed in the useEffect that syncs form state on task prop changes.

suggestions.msg: unreadCount derived from notifData?.data?.total could be a negative number if the API returns a negative total, resulting in a malformed badge.
suggestions.suggestion: Cap the value: const unreadCount = Math.max(0, (notifData?.data?.total as number) ?? 0);

suggestions.msg: crmItems and systemItems are defined at module scope and include a hardcoded badge: true on notifications — if notifications become a separate concern, this creates coupling between navigation data and fetch logic.
suggestions.suggestion: Consider deriving badge state from a separate config array that maps href to a badge key, keeping nav items pure.

suggestions.msg: Clean, minimal Zustand store — no issues found.
Clean aggregator module that correctly imports and re-exports all feature routers.
assigned_to defaults to 0, an invalid user ID, and TaskUpdate also allows None — inconsistent design where 0 and None both represent 'unassigned'
suggestions.suggestion: Use None as the sentinel for unassigned (remove default=0, change type to int | None), and treat None consistently in service/router

suggestions.msg: body.assigned_to or 0 collapses both 0 and None into 0; a tenant_id of 0 silently bypasses multi-tenancy isolation in the SQL WHERE clause (Rule 6)
suggestions.suggestion: Pass body.assigned_to directly; let the service decide how to handle None vs 0

suggestions.msg: list_tasks endpoint discards the second return value (total count) from service.list_tasks — count is re-fetched separately at line 111, creating an extra DB round-trip
suggestions.suggestion: Change service.list_tasks to return (items, total) and eliminate the redundant count_tasks call in the router

suggestions.msg: Well-structured FastAPI app factory with correct lifespan management, middleware ordering, global exception handling for AppException subclasses, and all routers included.

due_date is assigned at line 33 before the isinstance check at line 40 — if a date object is passed, line 41 overwrites it with a datetime constructed from an invalid date (datetime.min.time()) rather than preserving the original date
suggestions.suggestion: Move task.due_date assignment inside the isinstance check: after line 40, branch into set or convert, then assign once to task.due_date

suggestions.msg: Mixes Chinese comment ('任务服务') with English in the same codebase where all other class docstrings are English
suggestions.suggestion: Replace with English: 'Task service — backed by PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy async ORM.'

suggestions.msg: create_task does flush+refresh but other methods (update_task, complete_task) do flush then _fetch; inconsistent patterns across methods
suggestions.suggestion: Use flush + _fetch (same as update_task/complete_task) for consistency; _fetch already re-reads from DB which is what refresh does

suggestions.msg: get_my_tasks is defined but not called by any router endpoint — dead code unless consumed elsewhere
suggestions.suggestion: Confirm whether a /tasks/my endpoint is needed or remove the unused method

suggestions.msg: test_delete_task declares tenant_id_web fixture parameter but never uses it
suggestions.suggestion: Remove tenant_id_web from the function signature: async def test_delete_task(self, api_client: AsyncClient):

suggestions.msg: test_delete_task_not_found declares tenant_id_web fixture parameter but never uses it
suggestions.suggestion: Remove tenant_id_web from the function signature: async def test_delete_task_not_found(self, api_client: AsyncClient):

suggestions.msg: Bare except clause catches all exceptions including keyboard interrupts and SystemExit — rule 25
suggestions.suggestion: Replace bare except with the specific exception type: except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):

suggestions.msg: asynccontextmanager imported but used only at line 1034; redundant with the direct import since the decorator is what matters
suggestions.suggestion: No action needed — import is used; just flagging that the module-level comment at line 0 is missing

suggestions.msg: monkeypatch parameter declared in client_with_service fixture but never used inside the fixture body
suggestions.suggestion:
Remove the unused parameter: @pytest.fixture
def client_with_service():
